abbreviate_score.name: Abbreviate Score
abbreviate_score.description: If enabled, the score will be abbreviated (e.g. 10.00K, 1.00M).

accent_color.name: Accent Color:
accent_color.description: Choose a preset accent color or open the custom color picker.

align_receptors_to_hitbox.name: Align Receptors to Hitbox
align_receptors_to_hitbox.description: If checked, aligns mobile receptors with hitbox lanes. Useful for some layouts, but it can break scripts.

allow_phone_screensaver.name: Allow Phone Screensaver
allow_phone_screensaver.description:
If checked, the phone will sleep after going inactive for few seconds.
(The time depends on your phone's options)

anti_aliasing.name: Anti-Aliasing
anti_aliasing.description:
If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing, increases performance
at the cost of sharper visuals.

auto_pause.name: Auto Pause
auto_pause.description: If checked, the game automatically pauses if the screen isn't on focus.

bad_and_shit_break_combo.name: Bad and Shit Break Combo
bad_and_shit_break_combo.description:
If checked, hitting Bad or Shit notes will break your combo
and count as Combo Breaks instead of just Misses.

bad_hit_window.name: Bad Hit Window
bad_hit_window.description:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Bad" in milliseconds.

break_timer.name: Break Timer
break_timer.description: If checked, a timer appears when the next notes are still far away.

camera_zooms.name: Camera Zooms
camera_zooms.description: If unchecked, the camera won't zoom in on a beat hit.

change_window_border_color_with_note_hit.name: Change Window Border Color With Note Hit
change_window_border_color_with_note_hit.description: Can change the color of the window border when you hit a note.\n(Only for Windows 11, sry)

check_for_updates.name: Check for Updates
check_for_updates.description: On Release builds, turn this on to check for updates when you start the game.

color_accessibility.name: Color Accessibility
color_accessibility.description: Select several options according to your color blindness disorder.

combo_and_rating_in_camgame.name: Combo and Rating in camGame
combo_and_rating_in_camgame.description: If enabled, Combo and Ratings will be rendered in the camGame layer instead of camHUD.

combo_stacking.name: Combo Stacking
combo_stacking.description: If unchecked, Ratings and Combo won't stack, saving on System Memory and making them easier to read

disable_reset_button.name: Disable Reset Button
disable_reset_button.description: If checked, pressing Reset won't do anything.

discord_rich_presence.name: Discord Rich Presence
discord_rich_presence.description: Uncheck this to prevent accidental leaks, it will hide the Application from your "Playing" box on Discord

downscroll.name: Downscroll
downscroll.description: If checked, notes go Down instead of Up, simple enough.

drag_character.name: Drag Character
drag_character.description: If checked, holding a character with mouse/touch screen will move the position, just like in Codename Engine.

drag_stage_camera.name: Drag Stage Camera
drag_stage_camera.description:
If unchecked, stage camera cannot be dragged with mouse/touch screen.
Uncheck this if you prefer old Psych style.

dynamic_combo_digits.name: Dynamic Combo Digits
dynamic_combo_digits.description:
If checked, the combo will appear with two digits in first combo, and only
when it reaches 100 combo will it become three digits.

dynamic_controls_color.name: Dynamic Controls Color
dynamic_controls_color.description:
If checked, the mobile controls color will be set to the notes color in your settings.
(have effect during gameplay only)

enable_3d_cameras.name: Enable 3D Cameras
enable_3d_cameras.description:
Enables or disables 3D camera functionality.
Disabling this may improve performance by skipping 3D transformations.

end_countdown_seconds.name: End Countdown Seconds
end_countdown_seconds.description: How many seconds before the song ends the countdown appears (10-30).

extra_controls.name: Extra Controls
extra_controls.description:
Select how many extra buttons you prefer to have?
They can be used for mechanics with LUA or HScript.

flashing_lights.name: Flashing Lights
flashing_lights.description: Uncheck this if you're sensitive to flashing lights!

flawless_hit_window.name: Flawless!! Hit Window
flawless_hit_window.description:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Flawless!!" in milliseconds.

fps_counter_mode.name: FPS Counter Mode
fps_counter_mode.description: Choose how much performance info is shown in the top-left overlay.

framerate_mode.name: Framerate Mode
framerate_mode.description:
Choose how the engine handles update/draw timing.
Psych matches the classic engine behavior.

fullscreen_mode.name: Fullscreen Mode
fullscreen_mode.description: Borderless is capped to 1080p for better shader performance. Borderless Fix uses native monitor resolution.

game_over_vibration.name: Game Over Vibration
game_over_vibration.description: If checked, your device will vibrate at game over.

ghost_tapping.name: Ghost Tapping
ghost_tapping.description:
If checked, you won't get misses from pressing keys
while there are no notes able to be hit.

good_hit_window.name: Good Hit Window
good_hit_window.description:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Good" in milliseconds.

gradient_time_bar.name: Gradient Time Bar
gradient_time_bar.description: If checked, the time bar will be shaded according to the color of the character icon.

hardware_acceleration.name: Hardware Acceleration
hardware_acceleration.description:
If enabled, stores compatible images directly on the GPU to reduce RAM usage and improve rendering stability, especially on Android.
Recommended for most devices.

health_bar_opacity.name: Health Bar Opacity
health_bar_opacity.description: How much transparent should the health bar and icons be.

hey_intro.name: Hey Intro
hey_intro.description: If checked, BF and GF automatically do the Hey! animation when the countdown says Go!

hide_hud.name: Hide HUD
hide_hud.description: If checked, hides most HUD elements.

hitbox_design.name: Hitbox Design
hitbox_design.description: Choose how your hitbox should look like.

hitbox_position.name: Hitbox Position
hitbox_position.description: If checked, the hitbox will be put at the bottom of the screen, otherwise will stay at the top.

icon_bounce_type.name: Icon Bounce Type
icon_bounce_type.description: Changes the way the health icons bounce.

infinity_display.name: Infinity Display
infinity_display.description: If checked, extends the viewport vertically for taller screens while keeping the classic 16:9 gameplay area.

instant_window_close.name: Instant Window Close
instant_window_close.description: If checked, closing the game exits instantly instead of fading the window out.

key_viewer_color.name: Key Viewer Color:
key_viewer_color.description: Select the color for the key viewer buttons.

launcher_auto_start.name: Launcher Auto-start
launcher_auto_start.description: If checked, the Android launcher automatically starts the engine after 3 seconds.

lighter_hit_path.name: Lighter Hit Path
lighter_hit_path.description:
If unchecked, the full visual path will run instead of light visual path.
Unchecked this may cause LAG performance.

low_quality.name: Low Quality
low_quality.description:
If checked, disables some background details,
decreases loading times and improves performance.

middlescroll.name: Middlescroll
middlescroll.description: If checked, your notes get centered.

mobile_controls_opacity.name: Mobile Controls Opacity
mobile_controls_opacity.description: Selects the opacity for the mobile buttons (careful not to put it at 0 and lose track of your buttons).

mobile_trace_button.name: Mobile Trace Button
mobile_trace_button.description: If checked, shows the trace touch button on mobile builds.

mod_security.name: Mod Security
mod_security.description: If checked, scans mod Lua/HScript and skips scripts from mods with untrusted sensitive APIs.

modchart_debug_overlay.name: Modchart Debug Overlay
modchart_debug_overlay.description:
Shows modchart renderer stats.
Disabled by default because it has a performance cost.

mods_storage_location.name: Mods Storage Location
mods_storage_location.description:
Choose where Android mods and saved files should live.
INTERNAL uses scoped app storage, EXTERNAL uses public storage.

nf_rating_style.name: NF Rating Style
nf_rating_style.description: If checked, ratings and combo numbers bop in place instead of flying/fading.

note_splash_opacity.name: Note Splash Opacity
note_splash_opacity.description: How much transparent should the Note Splashes be.

note_splashes.name: Note Splashes:
note_splashes.description: Select your preferred note splash variation.

opponent_notes.name: Opponent Notes
opponent_notes.description: If unchecked, opponent notes get hidden.

optimize_hold_rendering.name: Optimize Hold Rendering
optimize_hold_rendering.description:
Optimizes hold arrow rendering for better performance.
NOT recommended for complex modcharts as holds may look incorrect.

options_menu_style.name: Options Menu Style
options_menu_style.description: Changes the Options menus between Plus cards and Psych classic.

over_accuracy.name: Over Accuracy
over_accuracy.description: If checked, perfect play can push accuracy past 100%, up to 200% by the end of the song.

pause_countdown.name: Pause Countdown
pause_countdown.description: If checked, resuming from pause plays a countdown similar to the intro countdown.

pause_music.name: Pause Music:
pause_music.description: What song do you prefer for the Pause Screen?

pop_up_score.name: Pop Up Score
pop_up_score.description: If unchecked, hitting notes will not show rating and combo popups. Useful on low-end devices.

rating_offset.name: Rating Offset
rating_offset.description:
Changes how late/early you have to hit for a "flawless!!"
Higher values mean you have to hit later.

results_state_at_end.name: Results State at End
results_state_at_end.description: If unchecked, endSong will not transition to ResultsState in Freeplay/Story Mode.

rgb_notes.name: RGB Notes
rgb_notes.description: If unchecked, uses Classic Psych 0.6.3-style note colors and root note assets.

safe_frames.name: Safe Frames
safe_frames.description:
Changes how many frames you have for
hitting a note earlier or late.

score_text_grow_on_hit.name: Score Text Grow on Hit
score_text_grow_on_hit.description:
If unchecked, disables the Score text growing
everytime you hit a note.

script_deprecation_warnings.name: Script Deprecation Warnings
script_deprecation_warnings.description: If checked, deprecated Lua/HScript compatibility APIs will print warnings to the debug console. Disable to silence noisy mods.

shaders.name: Shaders
shaders.description: If unchecked, disables shaders. They are used for visual effects and can be CPU intensive on weaker devices.

show_android_launcher.name: Show Android Launcher
show_android_launcher.description:
If checked, the Android launcher opens before the engine.
Turn it back on here if you disabled it from the launcher.

show_combo_numbers.name: Show Combo Numbers
show_combo_numbers.description: If unchecked, hides combo number popups when hitting notes.

show_combo_sprite.name: Show Combo Sprite
show_combo_sprite.description: If unchecked, hides the COMBO sprite popup when hitting notes.

show_early/late_sprites.name: Show Early/Late Sprites
show_early/late_sprites.description: Shows Early or Late tags on the top corners of the rating sprite depending on hit timing.

show_end_countdown.name: Show End Countdown
show_end_countdown.description: If checked, shows a countdown in the last seconds of the song.

show_hit_ms.name: Show Hit MS
show_hit_ms.description: Shows the millisecond timing error next to judgement popups.

show_key_viewer.name: Show Key Viewer
show_key_viewer.description: If checked, shows a key viewer displaying which keys are being pressed.

show_rating_sprite.name: Show Rating Sprite
show_rating_sprite.description: If unchecked, hides the rating sprite popup when hitting notes.

show_version_text_on_gameplay.name: Show Version Text on Gameplay
show_version_text_on_gameplay.description: If checked, shows the version text during gameplay.

show_watermark.name: Show Watermark
show_watermark.description: If checked, shows the watermark on screen.

sick_hit_window.name: Sick! Hit Window
sick_hit_window.description:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Sick!" in milliseconds.

smooth_health_bar.name: Smooth Health Bar
smooth_health_bar.description: If checked, the health bar will move smoothly instead of instantly.

sustains_as_one_note.name: Sustains as One Note
sustains_as_one_note.description:
If checked, Hold Notes can't be pressed if you miss,
and count as a single Hit/Miss.
Uncheck this if you prefer the old Input System.

system_score_multiplier.name: System Score Multiplier
system_score_multiplier.description: Choose the scoring system for note hits

time_bar.name: Time Bar:
time_bar.description: What should the Time Bar display?

time_text_bump.name: Time Text Bump
time_text_bump.description: If unchecked, disables the time text bump animation on beat.

title_intro_video.name: Title Intro Video
title_intro_video.description: If checked, plays the intro video before the title intro once per launch.

touch_pointer.name: Touch Pointer
touch_pointer.description: If checked, shows a touch pointer overlay for taps and drags.

uncap_fps.name: Uncap FPS
uncap_fps.description:
If checked, lets the renderer run as fast as possible while keeping updates bounded.
Useful for high refresh displays, but it can increase battery/GPU usage.

use_flawless_rating.name: Use Flawless Rating
use_flawless_rating.description: If checked, adds a tighter "Flawless!!" judgement above Sick.

use_psych_freeplay.name: Use Psych Freeplay
use_psych_freeplay.description: If checked, uses the classic Psych Engine Freeplay state instead of the PlusEngine Freeplay.

use_psych_score_text.name: Use Psych Score Text
use_psych_score_text.description: If checked, keeps the original Psych Engine score text format during gameplay.

vanilla_transition.name: Vanilla Transition
vanilla_transition.description: If checked, uses the vanilla Psych Engine transition instead of the custom one.

vsync.name: VSync
vsync.description:
If checked, enables VSync, fixing screen tearing at the cost of capping FPS to the monitor refresh rate.
Restart the game to fully apply it.

windows_gdi_effects.name: Windows GDI Effects
windows_gdi_effects.description: Allows Windows desktop GDI effects. Keep disabled unless you explicitly want mods to use them.

z_axis_scale.name: Z-Axis Scale
z_axis_scale.description:
Scales the Z-axis values to control perceived depth.
Higher values increase depth, lower values flatten it.
